text:
jess: quick check — uk-west warm pool showing a sudden spike, need a temporary +6 A100 standby for a customer demo tonight. Can we bump standby credit or ask vendor for a soft-hold? Need finance cc for invoice patch. ping @finance :eyes:
omar: we can route to vendor-psi, they say they have 6 spare but invoices are on hold until PO clears. I opened a ticket with them (TKT-8921) and emailed vendor-ops.
kiara: ok — if vendor can hold, we still need an alloc patch here. @jess can you open a PR to alloc-service? add a short lease and billing tag. sample terraform snippet to copy:
```
resource "redwood_alloc" "demo_spare" {
  count = 6
  sku   = "a100"
  tenant = "demo-team"
  lease = "4h"
}
```
jess: on it, creating PR now. finance contact is sara@redwood, but she's OOO until later — can someone cc billing-ops in case we need a manual exception?
raj: sara OOO until 15:00 PT. fallback: can finance-bot pre-approve a one-off under $5k? also infra-bot — can you publish current standby credit balance for uk-west?
infra-bot: infra-bot: Current standby_credits for uk-west: available=3, pending_vendor_offers=6, auto_approve_threshold=0. Details: https://internal.redwood/allocs/uk-west/credits
finance-bot: finance-bot: For one-off charges <$5k we can provisionally approve internal charge with engineering + PM signoff. Need PR link + PM ack.
kiara: :thumbsup: I'll add PM ack in the PR description.
jess: PR posted: https://git.redwood/allocs/pull/482 — adds `standby_override = 6` and `billing_tag = "demo-night"`. requesting review from @omar and @kiara.
omar: reviewing now. quick nit: rename var to `standby_credits_override` to match naming elsewhere.
kiara: lgtm otherwise, leaving final merge to @omar.
omar: I can't merge until finance-bot flags approved. @finance-bot can you add approval comment?
finance-bot: finance-bot: Provisional approval granted: charge $3,600 for demo standby. Approval ID BILL-2026-77. Please add invoice comment and link PR.
jess: :rocket: thanks — PR merged, vendor notified, monitoring alert set for queue usage. I will post an update to #release-war-room if anything changes.
